name: Expression Level Predictor
description: Predicts the Kosuri dataset prot target for an E. coli promoter/RBS pair using a model trained on Kosuri et al. If tss_best is absent, first ask once whether the user has an experimentally measured value for a matching construct context (integer offset from the promoter/RBS junction). Use it if supplied; if none, unknown, or the user wants to proceed, omit it and continue without TSS-derived RNA accessibility features. Do not infer or invent a measured TSS, and do not repeat the question after it has been answered for this context. The prediction is not an absolute protein concentration or a calibrated confidence interval.
